Hi ladies and gentlemen,
Thank you for thinking about me. It was a total of 3 that failed. I will ship back all 3 already upgraded with xt53 full copper heatsinks. I also will send 4 bm1373 brand new chips since I cannot do anything with them. If the team would consider sending me one of the Bsb 30’s or a magic miner 40t as a replacement for time and value of the equipment. I would truly be grateful.  Thank you very much
Danny
Note to the team: I'll pull the order and return history before replying.

Thank you very much George, sarah, Mike and team. After looking at both units if it could be kindly considered by George if I could please get one of the magic miner 40t units as an exchange for all three and the chips. Only because neither of the units have a slot for a ssd card. I also think there should be another $150 dollar credit on my account that was never used as per mike back when all this stuff happed. No rush I have been very patient. And I am also very greatful for your kindness and excellent service as a company.
Thank you Danny
